_what_this_is: A verbatim copy of repo-audit/board/non_build_checks.json's two lists, as
Elliot last vendored them. `NonBuildChecksVendoredTests` asserts that
`NonBuildChecks.swift` still agrees with this file, naming any name that is
⚠️ What that test proves, and what it cannot: it proves the Swift list
matches Elliot's LAST-KNOWN copy of repo-audit's file. It does not prove
this copy is still what repo-audit says today, and structurally cannot —
repo-audit is a separate private repository, and ci.yml's build-and-test
job runs with no token and no network on purpose. Reaching across would
mean granting exactly the credential an unattended bypassPermissions run
downstream could reach, for one JSON comparison.
So the residual is a human's: a name is added to EITHER copy only after
being seen on a real pull request (repo-audit's own header: `on n'ajoute
JAMAIS un nom ici sans avoir rejoue la PR qui l'a fait apparaitre`), and
whoever updates one is asked to update the other in the same change.
Read from repo-audit on 2026-08-09; identical to the 2026-08-08 seeding.
